title: Typed DataStorage-section adapter capture bounds
mode: Local implementation slice with generated fast validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound both const-copy and rvalue-transfer DRW_DataStorageSection adapter callbacks.
Account nested schema, payload, diagnostic, record-index, hash bucket, key, and dynamic string storage.
Refuse DXF output publication after section-count, aggregate-byte, or allocation capture failure.
Keep callback retention separate from DWG parser admission, the DataStorage payload cap, and AcDs semantic/output qualification.

implementation.behavior: Both callbacks use the same logical retained-byte estimate and sticky failure flag. The normal reader's rvalue route transfers ownership without a second nested deep copy; the estimate is not a process RSS or allocator-capacity bound.

limitations: This bounds the adapter's logical retained DataStorage model and refuses conversion after incomplete capture. It does not cap parser-side peak allocation, prove raw-section replay, qualify AcDs semantics, validate independent ACIS interpretation, or establish native consumer support. Work is uncommitted over the user's existing large worktree changes.
